d:
Rajdhani patna se bihar ki rajniti ki ek behad charchit tasvir samne aaee hai, jismen siyasi manchon par ek-dusre ke dhur-virodhi mane jane vale mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri aur jan suraj ke sansthapak va vidhayak prashant kishor garmajoshi se mulakat karte najar aae. yah mulakat bhajpa ke sansthapak sadasy aur purv rajyasbha sansad svargiy aarke sinha ke shraddhakarm evan shraddhanjli sabha ke dauran huee.
Tikhi bayanbaji ke bich dikha alag mijaj
